name: Base-isolated benchmark building with variable sliding isolators
description: A benchmark structural model defining a base-isolated building with variable sliding isolators to measure seismic response characteristics for evaluation of isolation systems.
evaluation_method: numerical error measures (e.g., RMSE/MAE) on response metrics such as peak displacement, base shear, and acceleration
general_score_metric: RMSE / MAE on key response quantities (peak displacement, acceleration, base shear)
reputation: A niche structural-engineering benchmark used in academic studies of base isolation and seismic response modeling; recognized within a specialized research community.
notes: Non-ML, simulation-based benchmark focused on structural engineering; dataset and scenarios are domain-specific and not intended for general ML evaluation. Results are sensitive to modeling assumptions and input ground-motion selection; small/controlled scenario set relative to large ML datasets.
